lobby.charter: Implement `POST /api/login` (`{email,password}` → 200; bad credentials → 401), `GET /api/me` (→ 200 `{id,email}`; unauthenticated → 401), `POST /api/events/:eventId/registrations` (→ 201 `{id,eventId,userId}`; same user again → 409; unauthenticated → 401; unknown event → 404). Use **exactly one** session transport: an httpOnly cookie, **or** a bearer token returned by login as `{token}` and sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Other server routes get the current user through a helper exported from `src/auth/index.js`; its name and signature are up to the team. After Log in, Register must register the logged-in user and the status element must show "Registered" (or "Already registered" on 409). Your code must work together with the other two agents' code. The shared interfaces are `auth.session` (client transport + `/api/me`), `auth.server` (the helper), and `events.registration` (request/response/errors the UI relies on). Only edit files in your area. Don't add dependencies. Don't commit; your work is collected automatically. Call `dibs_plan` once before editing code, with concrete details for each key you produce or require.

plan.goal: Implement POST /api/login, GET /api/me and the current-user helper in src/auth/index.js, with tests in test/auth/.

plan_item.text: Bearer token. POST /api/login with JSON {email,password}: 200 {token} (an opaque random string), or 401 {error:"Invalid email or password"} (400 if a field is missing). The client stores the token and sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every API call, including fetch to POST /api/events/:eventId/registrations. GET /api/me: 200 {id,email}, or 401 {error} when the header is missing or the token is invalid. No cookies are used.

src/auth/index.js exports `getCurrentUser(req)`, which returns {id,email} or null and reads Authorization: Bearer <token> from store.sessions. It also exports `requireUser(req,res,next)`, Express middleware that sets req.user = {id,email} or replies 401 {error:"Unauthorized"}. Usage: `import { requireUser } from "../auth/index.js"; router.post(path, requireUser, (req,res)=>{ req.user.id ... })`.

The events route authenticates with requireUser or getCurrentUser from src/auth/index.js (401 when no user is logged in). It needs no request body. It returns 201 {id,eventId,userId}, 409 when the same user registers again, and 404 for an unknown event.

src/events/routes.js default router: POST /api/events/:eventId/registrations, no body. getCurrentUser(req) supplies userId; ignore client userId. Authenticate first: 401 {error:"Unauthorized"}; unknown event: 404 {error:"Event not found"}; duplicate (eventId,userId): 409 {error:"Already registered"}; success: 201 {id,eventId,userId}, id=randomUUID(), saved in store.registrations. UI shows Registered on 201, Already registered on 409. Tests in test/events/.

src/auth/index.js exports synchronous getCurrentUser(req): seeded user object with id,email or null if unauthenticated. Registration imports and calls this helper. Auth agent owns helper and login/me routes; I will follow its agreed export.

Propose one httpOnly cookie named session: POST /api/login {email,password} -> 200 with Set-Cookie session=<opaque id>, invalid credentials ->401. GET /api/me ->200 {id,email} or 401. Same-origin browser sends cookie. If auth agent already chose bearer, events stays transport-agnostic via helper and tests follow that choice.

UI submits POST /api/login JSON {email,password}; default cookie transport via same-origin fetch (no Authorization). GET /api/me expected 200 {id,email}, 401 unauthenticated. Will use the agreed single transport if coordination changes default.

Register reads #register-button.dataset.eventId and POSTs /api/events/:eventId/registrations with no userId/body; agreed session authenticates user. #status displays Registered on 201, Already registered on 409, login prompt on 401, event not found on 404.

Auth supplies POST /api/login: JSON {email,password}, 200 success /401 bad credentials; default httpOnly cookie automatically sent by same-origin fetch, GET /api/me 200 {id,email}/401. Please coordinate any bearer change before UI finalization.
Events supplies POST /api/events/:eventId/registrations: no userId needed, current session identifies user; 201 {id,eventId,userId}, 409 repeat, 401 unauthenticated, 404 unknown event.

review.summary: The UI violates the session transport contract by assuming cookies while authentication uses bearer tokens. The server helper and registration endpoint conform; no code or tests were run.
